Q: Why can't a string_view be used as a condition expression? A:

If "nullish state" is a state that is not associated with any range, then there is no such state. A range [s, s) is a valid empty range for any iterator s [1], and a null pointer is an iterator (not dereferenceable, but this is not required). So a default-constructed std::string_view is associated with an empty range of characters, and so is std::string_view(p, p) for any p, including nullptr.

It isn't clear what merit could be derived from treating an empty range based at nullptr differently from any other empty range.

Q: What is the difference between CreateProcess and CreateProcessA? A:

CreateProcess is identical to either CreateProcessA ("ANSI") or to CreateProcessW ("Wide characters"), depending on whether you're compiling your code without or with the unicode option enabled (based on the definition of the UNICODE preprocessor constant.).

The difference is whether the string which you pass as a parameter should be an ANSI (8-bit character) or a unicode (16-bit character) string.

There are also alternatives, like ShellExecuteEx.

Q: Extract the selected text in custom iOS keyboard extension A: 
In a custom keyboard extension you cannot reliably obtain the full selected text. The system restricts access to small context windows via UITextDocumentProxy.

To work around this, use:
    •   clipboard-based workflows
    •   host app integration
    •   explicit user paste actions.
